metadata.name: Ecodesign for PHP
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for PHP code: sober ORM (Doctrine/Eloquent/PDO), generators, streams, OPcache, reused connections.

donnees.name: PHP — data access
donnees.description: Doctrine / Eloquent / PDO: load only what is read (RGESN Backend, GR491_Backend_2/3).

rules.title: Unbounded collection loaded
rules.description: ->get() or findAll() on an unbounded table hydrates every row into objects: memory and CPU proportional to the volume.
rules.recommendation: Paginate every exposed list; walk large volumes in batches with chunk()/cursor() (Eloquent) or toIterable() (Doctrine).

rules.title: Association walked in a loop (N+1)
rules.description: Reading an association inside a foreach fires one query per element.
rules.recommendation: Eager loading: with() (Eloquent) or a fetch join / DQL join (Doctrine); project the useful columns rather than full entities.

rules.title: Row-by-row writes
rules.description: save() inside a loop produces one database round trip per record.
rules.recommendation: Multi-row insert(), upsert() or batches; exists() rather than count() > 0.

memoire.name: PHP — memory and streams
memoire.description: Stream rather than materialise everything (RGESN Algorithms).

rules.title: File loaded entirely into memory
rules.description: file_get_contents or file() on a large file consumes memory proportional to its size.
rules.recommendation: Read as a stream (fopen plus block reads), fputcsv and streams for exports; generators (yield) to produce long sequences.

rules.title: Linear search in a large array
rules.description: in_array and array_search walk the whole array; repeated in a loop, the processing turns quadratic.
rules.recommendation: Index by key and test with isset($index[$k]) (constant time).

infra.name: PHP — execution and infrastructure
infra.description: Reuse connections, bound caches, lighten the dependency graph (RGESN Hosting).

rules.title: One HTTP connection per call
rules.description: curl_init() per request repeats DNS resolution and the TLS handshake on every call.
rules.recommendation: A shared, injected HTTP client (Guzzle); persistent PDO connections or a pool, depending on the platform.

rules.title: File cache with no purge
rules.description: A cache written to disk with neither expiry nor purge grows indefinitely: storage and backups inflated by dead entries.
rules.recommendation: A bounded, expiring cache (APCu, Redis with a TTL); OPcache enabled in production, optimised autoload (composer dump-autoload -o).
